rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for performing magic tricks as entertainment.

example.english: The magician can conjure up amazing tricks on stage, leaving the audience astonished.
example.traditional: 魔術師喺台上變魔術，觀眾睇到目瞪口呆。
example.jyutping: mo1 seot6 si1 hai2 toi1 soeng6 bin3 mo1 seot6 gun1 zung3 tai2 dou2 muk6 dang6 hau2 ngoi4

rows.note: Use this construction when magically calling a spirit, demon, or other supernatural being into existence or presence.

example.english: Before the ritual began, the sorcerer used magic to conjure a demon at the altar.
example.traditional: 儀式開始之前，巫師喺祭壇前召喚惡魔。
example.jyutping: ji4 sik1 hoi1 ci2 zi1 cin4 mou4 si1 hai2 zai3 taan4 cin4 ziu6 wun6 ok3 mo1
